subject: lavaan warning messages for mediation SEM model

messages.author: 9d8536fc48e8837a
messages.subject: lavaan warning messages for mediation SEM model
parts:
Hi all,

I want to use SEM to test if there is a relationship between certain chronic conditions (dichotomous variables beginning with H in the code) and Depression (latent variable CESD22) that may be mediated by two types of loneliness (ELONE and SLONE, also latent) which are allowed to covary. I have the latent variables under Measurement below, covariates (age20, Gender, Ethnicity, PartnerStatus, ELSI_est20) and I want to hold CESD20 (latent Depression scale in 2020) constant in my regressions to see if there is an effect on CESD22 (Depression scale in 2022). As I have categorical observed data, I want to use estimator WLSMV. Assuming I set this up correctly, I'm fairly new to R so I'm not confident in this, my code is:

model.cc <- '
  # Measurement
  CESD20 =~ HCESDa20 + HCESDb20 + HCESDc20 + HCESDd20 + HCESDe20r + HCESDf20 + HCESDg20 + HCESDh20r + HCESDj20
  CESD22 =~ HCESDa22 + HCESDb22 + HCESDc22 + HCESDd22 + HCESDe22r + HCESDf22 + HCESDg22 + HCESDh22r + HCESDj22
  ELONE =~ FLONEi20 + FLONEj20 + FLONEc20
  SLONE =~ FLONEd20r + FLONEg20r + FLONEh20r
 
  # Structural
  ELONE ~ age20 + Gender + Ethnicity + PartnerStatus + ELSI_est20 + el_dia*HDiabetes + el_hrt*HHeart + el_slp*HSleep +
    el_can*HCancer + el_str*HStroke + CESD20
  SLONE ~ age20 + Gender + Ethnicity + PartnerStatus + ELSI_est20 + sl_dia*HDiabetes + sl_hrt*HHeart + sl_slp*HSleep +
    sl_can*HCancer + sl_str*HStroke + CESD20
  CESD22 ~ age20 + Gender + Ethnicity + PartnerStatus + ELSI_est20 + d22_dia*HDiabetes + d22_hrt*HHeart + d22_slp*HSleep +
    d22_can*HCancer + d22_str*HStroke + d22_sl*SLONE + d22_el*ELONE + CESD20

  # Direct effects
  dir_dia := d22_dia
  dir_hrt := d22_hrt
  dir_slp := d22_slp
  dir_can := d22_can
  dir_str := d22_str
 
  # Indirect effects
  ind_dia_el := el_dia*d22_el
  ind_dia_sl := sl_dia*d22_sl
  ind_hrt_el := el_hrt*d22_el
  ind_hrt_sl := sl_hrt*d22_sl
  ind_slp_el := el_slp*d22_el
  ind_slp_sl := sl_slp*d22_sl
  ind_can_el := el_can*d22_el
  ind_can_sl := sl_can*d22_sl
  ind_str_el := el_str*d22_el
  ind_str_sl := sl_str*d22_sl
 
  # Total effect
  tot := d22_dia + d22_hrt + d22_slp + d22_can + d22_str + el_dia*d22_el + sl_dia*d22_sl + el_hrt*d22_el + sl_hrt*d22_sl +
    el_slp*d22_el + sl_slp*d22_sl + el_can*d22_el + sl_can*d22_sl + el_str*d22_el + sl_str*d22_sl
 
  # Covariances
  ELONE ~~ SLONE
  '

# Fit the model
  fit <- sem(model.cc, data = data_final, estimator="WLSMV", ordered=TRUE)
 
But I am getting the following warning messages and don't know why:
Warning messages:

1: In muthen1984(Data = X[[g]], wt = WT[[g]], ov.names = ov.names[[g]],  :
  lavaan WARNING: trouble constructing W matrix; used generalized inverse for A11 submatrix
2: In lavaan::lavaan(model = model.cc, data = data_final, ordered = TRUE,  :
  lavaan WARNING:
    the optimizer warns that a solution has NOT been found!
3: In lav_test_satorra_bentler(lavobject = NULL, lavsamplestats = lavsamplestats,  :
  lavaan WARNING: could not invert information matrix needed for robust test statistic
 
Does anybody have any ideas as to why I would get this error? I could not find the answer via google search.

Cheers,
Tom
